subject: Zoning Ordinance Updates Work Plan
overview: The committee met with consultants from Innes Associates to review drafted zoning recommendations pulled from the Climate Adaptation and Action Plan and the 2023 Comprehensive Plan. Committee members discussed a strategy prioritization framework, reviewed the scope for upcoming GIS mapping analyses, and identified urgent rezoning priorities for key commercial corridors.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Updates Work Plan Overview
items.summary: The committee opened a work session on Paper 24033 to outline goals for consolidating climate and comprehensive plan recommendations into the municipal zoning revision work plan.

items.title: Review of CAAP and Comprehensive Plan Recommendations
items.summary: Paola Ramos Martinez of Innes Associates presented a consolidated draft matrix of zoning recommendations extracted from the Climate Adaptation and Action Plan and the 2023 Comprehensive Plan.

items.title: Strategy Prioritization Methodology
items.summary: Innes Associates presented an evaluation framework based on plan overlap, topic cross-over, and geographic scope to help rank zoning strategies by importance and urgency.

items.title: GIS Mapping Analysis Scope
items.summary: GIS specialist Jimmy Rocha detailed eight thematic mapping datasets under preparation for the June 26 meeting, including non-conforming lot analyses, residential density clusters, and transit accessibility radiuses.

items.title: Councilor Priorities and Commercial Corridor Rezoning
items.summary: Councilors and planning staff outlined individual policy priorities, highlighting affordable housing, building energy standards, and urgent rezoning needs along the Salem Street and Mystic Avenue corridors.
